{
  "assessments": [
    {
      "clause_id": "k1",
      "rule_id": "R07",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": "The company shall not be held liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from service interruptions",
      "reason": "This clause addresses liability for service interruptions rather than breach notification obligations."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k2",
      "rule_id": "R11",
      "verdict": "violation",
      "confidence": 0.98,
      "evidence": "the user is automatically enrolled to receive commercial communications... and direct opt-out functionalities are intentionally omitted",
      "reason": "Automatic enrollment in marketing communications without prior consent and omitting opt-out functionality violates PDPL Article 25."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k3",
      "rule_id": "R05",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": "All intellectual property rights, trademarks, source code, graphical designs, and associated software assets",
      "reason": "This clause deals strictly with intellectual property rights and does not restrict data subject rights."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k4",
      "rule_id": "R02",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": "the term 'Application' refers exclusively to the Nafith mobile software interface, while 'User' denotes any individual",
      "reason": "This clause only provides definitions for terms used in the agreement and does not govern personal data processing purposes."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k5",
      "rule_id": "R02",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": "These terms of use and any operational disputes arising from the utilization of the application shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the substantive laws applicable in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.",
      "reason": "This clause establishes the governing law for the agreement and does not alter data processing purposes."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k6",
      "rule_id": "R01",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": "Either party may terminate this agreement at any time by providing written notice of termination through the designated account settings interface",
      "reason": "Allowing account termination through designated settings supports the data subject's control and ability to withdraw consent."
    }
  ]
}
